name: Deepdreck

source.note: The Crooked Moon (Legends of Avantris), appendix A. Numbers are the book's; the words are ours.

traits.name: Explosive Death
traits.summary: Explodes when it dies: 15-ft Emanation, DC 14 Dex save, 3d8 Poison (half on a success).
traits.text: The deepdreck explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the deepdreck. Failure: 13 (3d8) Poison damage. Success: half damage.

traits.name: Fragrance Aversion
traits.summary: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws within 10 ft of burning incense or a creature wearing Perfume.
traits.text: The deepdreck has Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws while within 10 feet of burning incense or a creature wearing Perfume.

traits.name: Tunneler
traits.summary: Burrows through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed, leaving a 5-ft-wide tunnel.
traits.text: The deepdreck can burrow through solid rock at half its Burrow Speed and leaves a tunnel 5 feet across behind it.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.summary: Two attacks, Claw or Putrid Emission in any mix.

actions.name: Putrid Emission
actions.summary: Ranged +6, 60 ft, 1d8+4 Poison; Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
actions.text: 8 (1d8 + 4) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the deepdreck's next turn.

summary: A cursed miner bloated with poison gas that claws, spits poison, tunnels through stone and bursts in a toxic cloud when slain; sweet scents leave it dazed.
